details: Haunted attraction on eight listed nights through November 7, 2026; check the dated ticket calendar before traveling.
Ticket window runs 7 p.m.–midnight. Guests already in line may enter later; this is not a final closing time.
November 6–7 are labeled Blackout. Confirm the format, age guidance and accessibility with the organizer before booking.
Location is approximate. Directions use the visitor address; confirm the entrance and parking with the organizer.
Haunted house in the Pollak Hospital Building at the Old Peoria State Hospital District; select nights through November 1, 2026.
Blackout runs October 30–November 1 in darkness, with one glowstick per group.
Ages 10+ recommended; under 5 prohibited. Children must walk and cannot be carried.
Standard nonmotorized wheelchairs use an altered route; electric wheelchairs cannot be accommodated. Tell the ticket booth about wheelchair access needs.
No on-property parking; use permitted street parking and avoid reserved neighboring lots, including Backroads Saloon.
Strobes, fog, loud sound and uneven surfaces are used. Casts, medical braces and crutches are not admitted; review the operator’s health restrictions before booking.
Location is approximate. Directions use the visitor address; confirm the entrance and parking with the organizer.

Tickets are date/time specific. The 30-minute slot is entry to the queue, not immediate admission; do not arrive more than 15 minutes early.
Ages 12+ recommended. Children under 12 must be accompanied by a responsible adult under the admission agreement.
Tight turns and ramps change elevation; no crawling. The organizer advises against attending if you cannot walk comfortably.
Required admission agreement includes a waiver and health restrictions. Strobes, darkness and other intense effects are used; review terms before booking.
Limited onsite tickets depend on unsold time slots. Advance changes are permitted except on the event day; sales are nonrefundable.
